package windows

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf16"
)

const inboxPrefix = "RFS_INBOX:"
const inboxEnvelopeLimit = 16 << 10

type inboxToken struct {
	SID              string `json:"sid"`
	AuthenticationID uint64 `json:"authentication_id"`
	SessionID        uint32 `json:"session_id"`
}
type inboxDirectory struct {
	Path            string `json:"path"`
	VolumeSerialHex string `json:"volume_serial_hex"`
	FileIndexHex    string `json:"file_index_hex"`
	Attributes      uint32 `json:"attributes"`
}
type inboxCache struct {
	File      int `json:"file"`
	Directory int `json:"directory"`
	NotFound  int `json:"not_found"`
}
type inboxStart struct {
	Kind             string         `json:"kind"`
	Stage            int            `json:"stage"`
	Nonce            string         `json:"nonce"`
	SourceSHA        string         `json:"source_sha"`
	ExecutableSHA256 string         `json:"executable_sha256"`
	ParentPID        int            `json:"parent_pid"`
	Computer         string         `json:"computer"`
	RootLocal        string         `json:"root_local"`
	ShareUNC         string         `json:"share_unc"`
	Drive            string         `json:"drive"`
	ExpectedToken    inboxToken     `json:"expected_token"`
	Directory        inboxDirectory `json:"directory"`
	CacheSeconds     inboxCache     `json:"cache_seconds"`
	OutputRoot       string         `json:"output_root"`
}
type inboxOrigin struct {
	ShareUNC   string   `json:"share_unc"`
	RootLocal  string   `json:"root_local"`
	SID        string   `json:"sid"`
	Server     string   `json:"server"`
	SessionIDs []string `json:"session_ids"`
	OpenIDs    []string `json:"open_ids"`
	OpenPaths  []string `json:"open_paths"`
	SHA256     string   `json:"sha256"`
}
type inboxAdmission struct {
	Kind             string      `json:"kind"`
	Stage            int         `json:"stage"`
	Nonce            string      `json:"nonce"`
	PID              int         `json:"pid"`
	ExecutableSHA256 string      `json:"executable_sha256"`
	Origin           inboxOrigin `json:"origin"`
}
type inboxMapping struct {
	Drive string `json:"drive"`
	UNC   string `json:"unc"`
}
type inboxEnvelope struct {
	Kind                   string       `json:"kind"`
	Stage                  int          `json:"stage"`
	Nonce                  string       `json:"nonce"`
	PID                    int          `json:"pid"`
	ExecutableSHA256       string       `json:"executable_sha256"`
	Token                  inboxToken   `json:"token"`
	Mapping                inboxMapping `json:"mapping"`
	ReceiptFile            string       `json:"receipt_file,omitempty"`
	ReceiptSHA256          string       `json:"receipt_sha256,omitempty"`
	Outcome                string       `json:"outcome,omitempty"`
	CleanupComplete        bool         `json:"cleanup_complete"`
	MechanismTraceComplete bool         `json:"mechanism_trace_complete"`
	Error                  string       `json:"error,omitempty"`
}
type inboxCall struct {
	Ordinal            int
	Name               string
	Started, Completed time.Time
	Error              string
}
type inboxReceipt struct {
	WatchOwnership                                                                                         inboxWatchOwnership
	LocalNameKnown                                                                                         bool
	LocalNameError                                                                                         string
	Request                                                                                                inboxStart
	PID                                                                                                    int
	Token                                                                                                  inboxToken
	ExecutableSHA256                                                                                       string
	Exposure, ACK, Expiry                                                                                  time.Time
	PreparedA, PreparedB, Initial, InitialRead, FirstOpen, NewIdentity, RetainedIdentity, OldRead, NewRead cacheGatePositiveValue
	Warm                                                                                                   []cacheGatePositiveValue
	Notifications                                                                                          []parentNativeCompletion
	Calls                                                                                                  []inboxCall
	Origins                                                                                                []inboxOrigin
	Pending                                                                                                bool
	MutationAttempted, MutationSucceeded                                                                   bool
	RenamePayloadHex                                                                                       string
	RenameClass                                                                                            uint32
	RenameError, MutatorCloseError                                                                         string
	LocalTarget, LocalRead                                                                                 cacheGatePositiveValue
	ReplacementAbsent                                                                                      bool
	LocalOracle                                                                                            bool
	NativeOracle                                                                                           string
	ObservationsComplete                                                                                   bool
	OriginComplete                                                                                         bool
	HelpersClean                                                                                           bool
	MappingAttempted, MappingCreated, MappingRemoved                                                       bool
	CleanupComplete                                                                                        bool
	MechanismTraceComplete                                                                                 bool
	Outcome, Error                                                                                         string
	CleanupErrors                                                                                          []string
}

func inboxHex(value string, n int) bool {
	if len(value) != n {
		return false
	}
	_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
	return err == nil
}
func inboxLocalPath(path string) bool {
	if len(path) < 4 || len(path) > 1024 || path[1] != ':' || path[2] != '\\' || !((path[0] >= 'A' && path[0] <= 'Z') || (path[0] >= 'a' && path[0] <= 'z')) || strings.ContainsAny(path, "/\x00") || strings.HasSuffix(path, "\\") {
		return false
	}
	for _, component := range strings.Split(path[3:], "\\") {
		if component == "" || component == "." || component == ".." || strings.ContainsAny(component, ":*?\"<>|") || strings.HasSuffix(component, ".") || strings.HasSuffix(component, " ") {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func inboxValidateStart(s inboxStart) error {
	if s.Kind != "start" || s.Stage != 0 || !inboxHex(s.Nonce, 64) || !inboxHex(s.SourceSHA, 40) || !inboxHex(s.ExecutableSHA256, 64) || s.ParentPID <= 0 {
		return errors.New("invalid start binding")
	}
	if len(s.Computer) == 0 || len(s.Computer) > 63 || strings.ContainsAny(s.Computer, "\\/.: \x00") {
		return errors.New("invalid computer name")
	}
	prefix := `\\` + s.Computer + `\`
	if !strings.HasPrefix(s.ShareUNC, prefix) || len(s.ShareUNC) == len(prefix) || strings.ContainsAny(s.ShareUNC[len(prefix):], "\\/:*?\"<>| \x00") {
		return errors.New("invalid exact computer share")
	}
	if len(s.Drive) != 2 || s.Drive[0] < 'D' || s.Drive[0] > 'Z' || s.Drive[1] != ':' {
		return errors.New("invalid drive")
	}
	if !inboxLocalPath(s.RootLocal) || !inboxLocalPath(s.OutputRoot) || s.Directory.Path != s.RootLocal || !inboxHex(s.Directory.VolumeSerialHex, 8) || !inboxHex(s.Directory.FileIndexHex, 16) || s.Directory.FileIndexHex == strings.Repeat("0", 16) || s.Directory.Attributes&0x10 == 0 || s.Directory.Attributes&0x400 != 0 {
		return errors.New("invalid owned directory")
	}
	if s.ExpectedToken.SID == "" || s.ExpectedToken.AuthenticationID == 0 || s.CacheSeconds != (inboxCache{10, 10, 5}) {
		return errors.New("invalid token or cache settings")
	}
	return nil
}
func inboxReadEnvelope(reader *bufio.Reader, out any) error {
	line, err := reader.ReadSlice('\n')
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("IPC line: %w", err)
	}
	if len(line) > inboxEnvelopeLimit || !bytes.HasPrefix(line, []byte(inboxPrefix)) {
		return errors.New("invalid IPC envelope")
	}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(line[len(inboxPrefix):]))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err = dec.Decode(out); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var extra any
	if err = dec.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
		return errors.New("trailing IPC payload")
	}
	return nil
}
func inboxUnique(values []string) bool {
	if len(values) == 0 || len(values) > 32 {
		return false
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, value := range values {
		if value == "" || len(value) > 1024 || seen[value] {
			return false
		}
		seen[value] = true
	}
	return true
}
func inboxValidateAdmission(s inboxStart, a inboxAdmission, stage, pid int) error {
	if a.Kind != "admit" || a.Stage != stage || (stage != 1 && stage != 2) || a.Nonce != s.Nonce || a.PID != pid || a.ExecutableSHA256 != s.ExecutableSHA256 {
		return errors.New("foreign or out-of-order admission")
	}
	o := a.Origin
	if o.ShareUNC != s.ShareUNC || o.RootLocal != s.RootLocal || o.SID != s.ExpectedToken.SID || !strings.EqualFold(o.Server, s.Computer) || !inboxHex(o.SHA256, 64) || !inboxUnique(o.SessionIDs) || !inboxUnique(o.OpenIDs) || len(o.OpenPaths) != len(o.OpenIDs) {
		return errors.New("origin fingerprint mismatch")
	}
	roles := map[string]bool{}
	for _, path := range o.OpenPaths {
		path = strings.TrimSuffix(path, `\`)
		if !strings.EqualFold(path, s.RootLocal) && !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(path), strings.ToLower(s.RootLocal+`\`)) {
			return errors.New("foreign open path")
		}
		if !inboxLocalPath(path) {
			return errors.New("unsafe open path")
		}
		roles[strings.ToLower(path)] = true
	}
	for _, role := range []string{s.RootLocal, s.RootLocal + `\v`, s.RootLocal + `\v\target`} {
		if !roles[strings.ToLower(role)] {
			return errors.New("required live open role missing")
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func inboxRenamePayload(target string) ([]byte, error) {
	if !inboxLocalPath(target) {
		return nil, errors.New("rename target is not a bounded absolute local path")
	}
	units := utf16.Encode([]rune(target))
	data := make([]byte, 20+2*len(units))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(data, 3)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(data[16:], uint32(2*len(units)))
	for i, v := range units {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(data[20+i*2:], v)
	}
	return data, nil
}

func inboxCallOrder(calls []inboxCall, openFailed bool) error {
	expected := []string{"pending", "mutator_open", "rename_flags3", "mutator_close"}
	if len(calls) < len(expected)+2 {
		return errors.New("missing measured calls")
	}
	i := 0
	for ; i < len(expected); i++ {
		if calls[i].Name != expected[i] {
			return errors.New("mutation call order changed")
		}
	}
	notifications := 0
	for i < len(calls) && calls[i].Name == "notify" {
		i++
		notifications++
		if i < len(calls) && calls[i].Name == "notify_rearm" {
			i++
		}
	}
	if notifications < 1 || notifications > 3 {
		return errors.New("notification bound changed")
	}
	rest := []string{"first_open", "new_identity", "retained_identity", "old_read", "new_read"}
	if openFailed {
		rest = rest[:1]
	}
	if len(calls)-i != len(rest) {
		return errors.New("extra or missing first observations")
	}
	for j, name := range rest {
		if calls[i+j].Name != name {
			return errors.New("first observation order changed")
		}
	}
	for j, call := range calls {
		if call.Ordinal != j+1 || call.Started.IsZero() || call.Completed.Before(call.Started) || (j > 0 && call.Started.Before(calls[j-1].Completed)) {
			return errors.New("invalid call ordinal or time")
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func inboxClassify(r *inboxReceipt, oldData, newData []byte) string {
	r.NativeOracle = parentRelativeIdentity(r.Initial, r.NewIdentity, r.RetainedIdentity, r.OldRead, r.NewRead, oldData, newData)
	if r.MechanismTraceComplete {
		return "invalid_mechanism_claim"
	}
	if !r.CleanupComplete || !r.HelpersClean || !r.MappingRemoved || len(r.CleanupErrors) > 0 {
		return "cleanup_incomplete"
	}
	if !r.MutationAttempted || !r.Pending {
		return "setup_refusal"
	}
	payload, payloadErr := inboxRenamePayload(r.Request.RootLocal + `\v\target`)
	if !r.MutationSucceeded || r.ACK.IsZero() || r.RenameClass != 22 || payloadErr != nil || r.RenamePayloadHex != hex.EncodeToString(payload) || r.RenameError != "" {
		return "reference_mutation_refusal"
	}
	if !r.OriginComplete || len(r.Origins) != 2 {
		return "origin_incomplete"
	}
	if !r.ObservationsComplete || len(r.Notifications) == 0 {
		return "observation_incomplete"
	}
	if r.MutatorCloseError != "" {
		return "cleanup_incomplete"
	}
	if inboxCallOrder(r.Calls, r.FirstOpen.Error != "") != nil {
		return "observation_incomplete"
	}
	for _, n := range r.Notifications {
		if !n.Drained || (n.ErrorCode != 0 && n.ErrorCode != parentErrorNotifyEnum) || n.Completed.Before(r.ACK) || n.Completed.After(r.ACK.Add(850*time.Millisecond)) {
			return "observation_incomplete"
		}
	}
	if r.Exposure.IsZero() || !r.Expiry.Equal(r.Exposure.Add(5*time.Second)) || r.ACK.Before(r.Exposure) || !r.ACK.Before(r.Expiry) {
		return "timing_incomplete"
	}
	values := []cacheGatePositiveValue{r.FirstOpen}
	if r.FirstOpen.Error == "" {
		values = append(values, r.NewIdentity, r.RetainedIdentity, r.OldRead, r.NewRead)
	}
	for _, value := range values {
		if !value.Started.Before(r.Expiry) || !value.Completed.Before(r.Expiry) {
			return "timing_incomplete"
		}
		if !parentWithinWindow(value, r.ACK, r.Expiry) {
			return "native_behavior_failure"
		}
	}
	if !r.LocalNameKnown || r.LocalTarget.Error != "" || r.LocalTarget.Identity == 0 || r.LocalTarget.Started.IsZero() || r.LocalRead.Error != "" || r.LocalRead.Started.IsZero() || r.LocalRead.Digest == "" {
		return "local_truth_incomplete"
	}
	if r.FirstOpen.Error != "" || r.NativeOracle != "distinct_native_identity_and_preserved_bytes" || !r.LocalOracle {
		return "native_behavior_failure"
	}
	return "native_behavior_pass"
}
func inboxTestStart() inboxStart {
	return inboxStart{Kind: "start", Nonce: strings.Repeat("a", 64), SourceSHA: strings.Repeat("b", 40), ExecutableSHA256: strings.Repeat("c", 64), ParentPID: 10, Computer: "HOST", RootLocal: `C:\owned\share`, ShareUNC: `\\HOST\nonce-share`, Drive: "X:", ExpectedToken: inboxToken{"S-1-5-21-1", 5, 1}, Directory: inboxDirectory{`C:\owned\share`, "12345678", "0000000000000123", 16}, CacheSeconds: inboxCache{10, 10, 5}, OutputRoot: `C:\owned\output`}
}
func inboxTestAdmission(stage int) inboxAdmission {
	s := inboxTestStart()
	return inboxAdmission{Kind: "admit", Stage: stage, Nonce: s.Nonce, PID: 20, ExecutableSHA256: s.ExecutableSHA256, Origin: inboxOrigin{ShareUNC: s.ShareUNC, RootLocal: s.RootLocal, SID: s.ExpectedToken.SID, Server: s.Computer, SessionIDs: []string{"s"}, OpenIDs: []string{"r", "v", "a"}, OpenPaths: []string{s.RootLocal, s.RootLocal + `\v`, s.RootLocal + `\v\target`}, SHA256: strings.Repeat("d", 64)}}
}
func TestInboxReferenceIPC(t *testing.T) {
	s := inboxTestStart()
	if err := inboxValidateStart(s); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*inboxStart){"wrong_cache": func(s *inboxStart) { s.CacheSeconds.NotFound = 10 }, "unc_alias": func(s *inboxStart) { s.ShareUNC = `\\localhost\nonce-share` }, "path_escape": func(s *inboxStart) { s.RootLocal = `C:\owned\..\share` }, "reparse": func(s *inboxStart) { s.Directory.Attributes |= 0x400 }, "drive": func(s *inboxStart) { s.Drive = "C:" }, "zero_identity": func(s *inboxStart) { s.Directory.FileIndexHex = strings.Repeat("0", 16) }, "token": func(s *inboxStart) { s.ExpectedToken.AuthenticationID = 0 }} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			bad := s
			mutate(&bad)
			if inboxValidateStart(bad) == nil {
				t.Fatal("unsafe start admitted")
			}
		})
	}
	good, _ := json.Marshal(s)
	for name, line := range map[string]string{"valid": inboxPrefix + string(good) + "\n", "prefix": string(good) + "\n", "trailing": inboxPrefix + string(good) + "{}\n", "unknown": inboxPrefix + strings.TrimSuffix(string(good), "}") + `,"extra":1}` + "\n", "oversize": inboxPrefix + strings.Repeat(" ", inboxEnvelopeLimit) + "\n", "unterminated": inboxPrefix + string(good)} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var v inboxStart
			err := inboxReadEnvelope(bufio.NewReaderSize(strings.NewReader(line), inboxEnvelopeLimit+1), &v)
			if (err == nil) != (name == "valid") {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected decode: %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestInboxReferenceOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	s := inboxTestStart()
	if err := inboxValidateAdmission(s, inboxTestAdmission(1), 1, 20); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mutations := map[string]func(*inboxAdmission){"wrong_share": func(a *inboxAdmission) { a.Origin.ShareUNC += "x" }, "wrong_directory": func(a *inboxAdmission) { a.Origin.RootLocal += "x" }, "wrong_sid": func(a *inboxAdmission) { a.Origin.SID += "x" }, "wrong_server": func(a *inboxAdmission) { a.Origin.Server = "OTHER" }, "foreign_open": func(a *inboxAdmission) { a.Origin.OpenPaths[0] = `C:\other` }, "missing_role": func(a *inboxAdmission) { a.Origin.OpenPaths[0] = s.RootLocal + `\other` }, "duplicate_id": func(a *inboxAdmission) { a.Origin.OpenIDs[1] = a.Origin.OpenIDs[0] }, "missing_id": func(a *inboxAdmission) { a.Origin.OpenIDs = nil }, "wrong_pid": func(a *inboxAdmission) { a.PID++ }, "wrong_nonce": func(a *inboxAdmission) { a.Nonce += "f" }, "wrong_executable": func(a *inboxAdmission) { a.ExecutableSHA256 = strings.Repeat("f", 64) }, "wrong_stage": func(a *inboxAdmission) { a.Stage = 2 }, "path_traversal": func(a *inboxAdmission) { a.Origin.OpenPaths[0] = s.RootLocal + `\..\other` }}
	for name, mutate := range mutations {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			a := inboxTestAdmission(1)
			mutate(&a)
			if inboxValidateAdmission(s, a, 1, 20) == nil {
				t.Fatal("resource fingerprint bypass admitted")
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestInboxReferenceRenamePayload(t *testing.T) {
	path := `C:\owned\v\target-𝄞`
	data, err := inboxRenamePayload(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	units := utf16.Encode([]rune(path))
	if len(data) != 20+len(units)*2 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data) != 3 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[16:]) != uint32(len(units)*2) || !bytes.Equal(data[4:16], make([]byte, 12)) {
		t.Fatal("wrong FILE_RENAME_INFO ABI")
	}
	for i, u := range units {
		if binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[20+i*2:]) != u {
			t.Fatal("UTF16 payload changed")
		}
	}
	for _, bad := range []string{`relative`, `\\host\share\target`, `C:\owned\..\target`, "C:\\bad\x00name", `C:\owned\target:stream`, `C:\owned\target.`, "C:\\" + strings.Repeat("x", 1024)} {
		if _, err := inboxRenamePayload(bad); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("unsafe target accepted: %q", bad)
		}
	}
}
func inboxTestReceipt() (inboxReceipt, []byte, []byte) {
	a, b := cacheGatePositivePayload(257, 0x17), cacheGatePositivePayload(769, 0x89)
	ack := time.Unix(2000000000, 0)
	value := func(id uint64, size int64) cacheGatePositiveValue {
		return cacheGatePositiveValue{Identity: id, Volume: 7, Size: size, Started: ack.Add(20 * time.Millisecond), Completed: ack.Add(21 * time.Millisecond)}
	}
	r := inboxReceipt{Request: inboxTestStart(), RenameClass: 22, Exposure: ack.Add(-time.Second), ACK: ack, Expiry: ack.Add(4 * time.Second), Initial: value(1, 257), FirstOpen: value(0, 0), NewIdentity: value(2, 769), RetainedIdentity: value(1, 257), OldRead: value(0, 0), NewRead: value(0, 0), Pending: true, MutationAttempted: true, MutationSucceeded: true, OriginComplete: true, Origins: []inboxOrigin{inboxTestAdmission(1).Origin, inboxTestAdmission(2).Origin}, ObservationsComplete: true, HelpersClean: true, MappingCreated: true, MappingRemoved: true, CleanupComplete: true, LocalOracle: true, Notifications: []parentNativeCompletion{{Drained: true, Count: 20, Completed: ack.Add(10 * time.Millisecond)}}}
	payload, _ := inboxRenamePayload(r.Request.RootLocal + `\v\target`)
	r.RenamePayloadHex = hex.EncodeToString(payload)
	r.LocalNameKnown = true
	r.LocalTarget = value(2, 769)
	r.LocalRead = value(0, 0)
	r.LocalRead.Count = 769
	r.LocalRead.Digest = cacheGatePositiveDigest(b)
	r.OldRead.Count = 257
	r.OldRead.Digest = cacheGatePositiveDigest(a)
	r.NewRead.Count = 769
	r.NewRead.Digest = cacheGatePositiveDigest(b)
	for i, name := range []string{"pending", "mutator_open", "rename_flags3", "mutator_close", "notify", "first_open", "new_identity", "retained_identity", "old_read", "new_read"} {
		start := ack.Add(time.Duration(i-3) * time.Millisecond)
		r.Calls = append(r.Calls, inboxCall{i + 1, name, start, start, ""})
	}
	return r, a, b
}
func TestInboxReferenceOracle(t *testing.T) {
	r, a, b := inboxTestReceipt()
	if got := inboxClassify(&r, a, b); got != "native_behavior_pass" {
		t.Fatal(got)
	}
	cases := map[string]struct {
		mutate func(*inboxReceipt)
		want   string
	}{
		"both_old":        {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.NewIdentity.Identity = r.Initial.Identity }, "native_behavior_failure"},
		"both_new":        {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.RetainedIdentity.Identity = r.NewIdentity.Identity }, "native_behavior_failure"},
		"wrong_old_bytes": {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.OldRead.Digest = r.NewRead.Digest }, "native_behavior_failure"},
		"wrong_new_bytes": {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.NewRead.Count = 257 }, "native_behavior_failure"},
		"api_error":       {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.NewIdentity.Error = "access denied" }, "native_behavior_failure"},
		"late":            {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.NewRead.Completed = r.ACK.Add(time.Second + 1) }, "native_behavior_failure"},
		"ttl_elapsed": {func(r *inboxReceipt) {
			r.Exposure = r.ACK.Add(-6 * time.Second)
			r.Expiry = r.Exposure.Add(5 * time.Second)
		}, "timing_incomplete"},
		"ack_at_expiry": {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.Exposure = r.ACK.Add(-5 * time.Second); r.Expiry = r.ACK }, "timing_incomplete"},
		"checks_after_expiry": {func(r *inboxReceipt) {
			r.Exposure = r.ACK.Add(-5*time.Second + time.Millisecond)
			r.Expiry = r.Exposure.Add(5 * time.Second)
		}, "timing_incomplete"},
		"unknown_local_open":  {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.LocalTarget.Error = "access denied"; r.LocalOracle = false }, "local_truth_incomplete"},
		"unknown_local_read":  {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.LocalRead.Error = "read failed"; r.LocalOracle = false }, "local_truth_incomplete"},
		"missing_local_truth": {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.LocalTarget = cacheGatePositiveValue{}; r.LocalOracle = false }, "local_truth_incomplete"},
		"unknown_name_truth": {func(r *inboxReceipt) {
			r.LocalNameKnown = false
			r.LocalNameError = "access denied"
			r.LocalOracle = false
		}, "local_truth_incomplete"},
		"known_local_mismatch": {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.LocalOracle = false }, "native_behavior_failure"},
		"ttl_reset":            {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.Expiry = r.ACK.Add(5 * time.Second) }, "timing_incomplete"},
		"missing_origin":       {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.OriginComplete = false }, "origin_incomplete"},
		"ordinary_rename":      {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.RenameClass = 3 }, "reference_mutation_refusal"},
		"wrong_flags":          {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.RenamePayloadHex = "01000000" + r.RenamePayloadHex[8:] }, "reference_mutation_refusal"},
		"failed_mutation":      {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.MutationSucceeded = false }, "reference_mutation_refusal"},
		"missing_pending":      {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.Pending = false }, "setup_refusal"},
		"unknown_completion":   {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.Notifications[0].Drained = false }, "observation_incomplete"},
		"notify_error":         {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.Notifications[0].ErrorCode = 5 }, "observation_incomplete"},
		"notify_late":          {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.Notifications[0].Completed = r.ACK.Add(time.Second) }, "observation_incomplete"},
		"changed_order":        {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.Calls[6].Name = "old_read" }, "observation_incomplete"},
		"duplicate_first":      {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.Calls = append(r.Calls, r.Calls[5]) }, "observation_incomplete"},
		"forced_exit":          {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.CleanupComplete = false }, "cleanup_incomplete"},
		"unknown_drain":        {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.HelpersClean = false }, "cleanup_incomplete"},
		"mapping_retained":     {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.MappingRemoved = false }, "cleanup_incomplete"},
		"close_error":          {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.CleanupErrors = []string{"CloseHandle failed"} }, "cleanup_incomplete"},
		"mechanism_claim":      {func(r *inboxReceipt) { r.MechanismTraceComplete = true }, "invalid_mechanism_claim"},
	}
	for name, c := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			r, a, b := inboxTestReceipt()
			c.mutate(&r)
			if got := inboxClassify(&r, a, b); got != c.want {
				t.Fatalf("oracle bypass: got %s want %s", got, c.want)
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("native_rescan_is_not_wire_proof", func(t *testing.T) {
		r, a, b := inboxTestReceipt()
		r.Notifications[0].Count = 0
		r.Notifications[0].ErrorCode = parentErrorNotifyEnum
		if got := inboxClassify(&r, a, b); got != "native_behavior_pass" || r.MechanismTraceComplete {
			t.Fatal(got)
		}
	})
}

type inboxWatchOwnership struct {
	Submitted                                bool
	TerminalKnown                            bool
	PinsReleased                             bool
	Retained                                 bool
	LastCompletion                           parentNativeCompletion
	CancelError, DrainError, EventCloseError string
	EventClosed                              bool
}

func (s *inboxWatchOwnership) Submit() error {
	if s.PinsReleased || s.Retained || (s.Submitted && !s.TerminalKnown) {
		return errors.New("watch submission has unresolved ownership")
	}
	s.Submitted = true
	s.TerminalKnown = false
	return nil
}
func (s *inboxWatchOwnership) Completion(value parentNativeCompletion) {
	s.LastCompletion = value
	s.TerminalKnown = value.Drained && !value.Completed.IsZero() && ((value.ErrorCode == 0 && value.Error == "") || value.ErrorCode == 995 || value.ErrorCode == parentErrorNotifyEnum)
}
func (s *inboxWatchOwnership) Release() bool {
	if s.PinsReleased || s.Retained {
		return false
	}
	if s.Submitted && !s.TerminalKnown {
		s.Retained = true
		return false
	}
	s.PinsReleased = true
	return true
}
func TestInboxReferenceWatchOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	for _, code := range []uint32{0, 995, parentErrorNotifyEnum} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(code), func(t *testing.T) {
			var s inboxWatchOwnership
			if err := s.Submit(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			s.Completion(parentNativeCompletion{Drained: true, Completed: time.Now(), ErrorCode: code})
			if !s.Release() || s.Retained {
				t.Fatal("known terminal retained")
			}
		})
	}
	for name, value := range map[string]parentNativeCompletion{"pending": {Completed: time.Now(), ErrorCode: 996}, "unknown_done": {Drained: true, Completed: time.Now(), ErrorCode: 5}, "unknown_error_no_code": {Drained: true, Completed: time.Now(), Error: "unclassified error"}, "missing_provenance": {Drained: true}, "timeout": {}} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var s inboxWatchOwnership
			_ = s.Submit()
			s.Completion(value)
			if s.Release() || !s.Retained || s.PinsReleased {
				t.Fatal("unknown kernel owner released")
			}
			if s.Submit() == nil {
				t.Fatal("retained owner resubmitted")
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("rearm_keeps_pins", func(t *testing.T) {
		var s inboxWatchOwnership
		_ = s.Submit()
		s.Completion(parentNativeCompletion{Drained: true, Completed: time.Now()})
		if err := s.Submit(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if s.TerminalKnown || s.PinsReleased || s.Release() {
			t.Fatal("rearmed pending owner released")
		}
	})
	t.Run("rearm_requires_terminal", func(t *testing.T) {
		var s inboxWatchOwnership
		_ = s.Submit()
		if s.Submit() == nil {
			t.Fatal("pending owner resubmitted")
		}
	})
	t.Run("failed_initial_submission", func(t *testing.T) {
		var s inboxWatchOwnership
		if !s.Release() || s.Release() {
			t.Fatal("nonpending release must happen once")
		}
	})
}
